text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa commended our daily 
hard work and treated us to some "super 
delicious ice cream"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to its name, it was utterly 
delicious... and both mind and body were 
thoroughly healed.
